name: mathewburnett
description: Mathew Burnett's agent skills, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: mb-skills
plugins.description: All five skills below, bundled together. Scaffolds a repo's shipping path — ship/land scripts, versioning, health endpoint, and branch topology — plus architecture mapping, wayfinder star-maps, and reMarkable publishing.

plugins.name: architecture-map
plugins.description: Generates an architectural map of the repository, useful for understanding dependencies and components for new features or refactors.

plugins.name: setup-git-workflow
plugins.description: Scaffolds the necessary Git workflow plumbing in a repository (e.g., PR review structure, CI integration points) to ensure consistent development practices from feature branch to merge.

plugins.name: setup-laravel-react-project
plugins.description: Bootstraps a Laravel + React project the way Mathew likes it — Dockerized skeleton, CI, git workflow, engineering-skill config, and a graphify knowledge graph.

plugins.name: starmap
plugins.description: Render a wayfinder map as a pannable star-map — tickets as stars coloured by status, blocking as flowing edges, fog at the rim.

plugins.name: remarkable-publish
plugins.description: Render a document or drawing and push it to a reMarkable tablet, via a self-hosted protomarkable MCP server.
